title: Orion Enterprise Cloud Modernization Program
description: Multi-year program to modernize Orion's regional data centers onto a managed cloud platform with migration, security and support services.
intro: Orion Logistics Holdings (Orion) operates freight, warehousing and last-mile delivery services across 14 countries. Orion intends to consolidate three regional data centers onto a managed enterprise cloud platform over a three-year program.

This Request for Proposal (RFP-2026-014) invites qualified vendors to propose a platform, migration services and ongoing support. All information in this document is confidential to Orion and its prospective vendors.

sections.title: Introduction and Background
intro: Orion currently runs approximately 900 workloads across data centers in Rotterdam, Atlanta and Singapore. The program aims to reduce infrastructure cost, improve resilience and standardize security controls.
This section describes the background of the program. Detailed requirements follow in Sections 3 through 11.

items.text: Vendors must acknowledge receipt of this RFP by email to procurement@orionlogistics.example within five business days.

sections.title: Submission Instructions
intro: The following instructions apply to all proposals. Orion reserves the right to reject non-compliant proposals without evaluation.

items.text: Proposals must be submitted electronically via the Orion procurement portal no later than 30 October 2026, 17:00 UTC.
The technical proposal shall not exceed 60 pages, excluding appendices and CVs.
Vendors must complete the Pricing Template (Attachment B) in the format provided; alternative pricing formats will not be evaluated.
Vendors must attach a signed Non-Collusion Declaration (Attachment C) and a Certificate of Insurance (Attachment D).
Questions regarding this RFP must be submitted in writing by 9 October 2026; answers will be shared with all vendors.
Proposals must remain valid for 120 days from the submission deadline.
Vendors must complete the Vendor Security Assessment workbook (Attachment E) and return it with the proposal.

sections.title: Company Information
intro: Orion seeks to understand the stability and background of each vendor.

items.text: Provide a company overview including year founded, ownership structure, headquarters location, and number of employees.
Describe your financial stability, including the last three years of revenue growth or audited statement availability.
Identify your primary markets and the number of enterprise customers currently using your platform.
List strategic technology partnerships relevant to cloud modernization (e.g., hyperscaler partner tiers).
Confirm whether your company holds a minority-owned or women-owned business certification (MBE/WBE).
items.note: No evidence exists; must end Needs Evidence.

items.text: Describe any litigation, regulatory actions, or bankruptcy proceedings in the last five years.

sections.title: Functional and Technical Requirements
intro: The following requirements describe the platform capabilities Orion expects.

items.text: The platform shall provide a unified management console covering compute, data, and observability workloads.
The solution must support workflow automation with a visual designer and version-controlled definitions.
The platform shall expose REST and GraphQL APIs with OAuth 2.0 authentication and published rate limits.
Describe the reporting and dashboard capabilities, including scheduled report distribution and export formats.
The solution should provide native mobile access or a responsive web interface conforming to WCAG 2.1 AA.
Describe your release cadence and how customers preview and control feature rollouts.
The platform must support role-based access control with custom roles and delegated administration.
Describe integration options with ServiceNow and Jira for incident and change workflows.
The solution shall support bulk data import and export in CSV and Parquet formats.
Provide a sandbox environment for integration testing at no additional cost.
The platform must retain audit logs of all administrative actions for at least 12 months.
Describe the platform's support for multi-tenancy and tenant data isolation.

sections.title: Architecture, Hosting and Performance
intro: Orion requires a resilient, scalable platform hosted in regions aligned with its operations.

items.text: Describe your hosting model, including cloud providers and available regions in the EU and North America.
The platform shall support at least 5,000 concurrent users per tenant without degradation.
The vendor must commit to a minimum monthly availability of 99.9% with service credits.
Describe your disaster recovery capabilities, including RPO and RTO targets and the frequency of failover testing.
Confirm that the platform can be deployed as a fully air-gapped, customer-hosted appliance certified under Common Criteria EAL4+.
items.note: Trap: no appliance offering exists in the knowledge base.

items.text: Describe how the platform scales horizontally and any documented performance benchmarks.
Confirm support for data residency in a South American region (São Paulo, Brazil).
Describe your approach to zero-downtime upgrades and maintenance windows.

sections.title: Security Requirements
intro: Security is a primary evaluation criterion. Responses should reference documented controls rather than intentions.

items.text: The vendor shall provide SAML 2.0 based single sign-on and enforce multi-factor authentication for all administrative users.
All customer data must be encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.2 or higher.
Describe your encryption key management, including customer-managed keys and rotation frequency.
The vendor must perform annual third-party penetration tests and share an executive summary on request.
Provide evidence of ISO 27001 certification, including the certificate scope and expiry date.
items.note: Trap: Northstar holds SOC 2, not ISO 27001.

items.text: Confirm whether your platform holds FedRAMP Moderate authorization.
Describe your security incident response process, including customer notification timelines.
Provide a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report or describe its availability.
Confirm whether the platform is assessed as PCI DSS Level 1 compliant for cardholder data.
Describe secure software development practices, including code review, dependency scanning, and SAST.
Describe your roadmap for post-quantum cryptography (quantum-safe algorithms).
Describe logging and monitoring capabilities, including SIEM integration and log retention periods.

sections.title: Privacy and Data Protection
intro: Orion processes personal data of employees and customers in the EU, UK, US and Canada.

items.text: The vendor must comply with GDPR and provide a Data Processing Agreement including Standard Contractual Clauses.
Describe data retention and deletion procedures at contract termination, including certification of deletion.
Provide your current list of subprocessors and the notification process for changes.
Confirm willingness to sign a HIPAA Business Associate Agreement (BAA) covering protected health information.
Describe how data subject access requests are supported within statutory timelines.
Confirm the geographic regions where customer data is stored and processed.

sections.title: Implementation and Migration
intro: Orion expects a structured program with clear governance and minimal operational disruption.

items.text: Describe your implementation methodology, phases, and typical timeline for an enterprise deployment.
The vendor shall provide a named project manager and a detailed project plan within 10 business days of contract signature.
Describe your approach to migrating workloads from legacy data centers, including tooling and rollback procedures.
Describe training offerings for administrators and end users, including formats and materials.
Describe your change management and communications approach for user adoption.
Describe hypercare support following go-live and its duration.
Provide a risk register template and describe how risks are escalated during implementation.
Confirm whether implementation services can be delivered by staff holding Japanese and Korean language proficiency for APAC sites.

sections.title: Support and Service Levels
intro: Orion operates 24 hours a day; support commitments are contractual.

items.text: Describe your support tiers, hours of coverage, and contact channels.
Provide severity definitions with target response and resolution times for each severity level.
The vendor must provide 24x7 support for Severity 1 incidents.
Describe the escalation path for unresolved incidents, including named escalation contacts.
The vendor shall provide a customer success manager for the duration of the contract.
Confirm whether you offer a 99.999% availability commitment for a premium fee.
Describe planned maintenance notification periods and blackout-window options.

sections.title: Commercial and Legal
intro: Orion expects complete commercial responses and does not negotiate omitted items after award.

items.text: Describe your pricing model, including licensing metrics and volume discounts.
State your standard payment terms and invoicing frequency.
Describe your standard contract term, renewal terms, and termination for convenience provisions.
State your limitation of liability position and any proposed caps.
Provide evidence of insurance coverage, including cyber liability, professional indemnity, and general liability limits.
Confirm willingness to place the platform source code in escrow with an independent escrow agent.
Describe warranties provided for the platform and services.
Confirm acceptance of Orion's standard terms and conditions (Attachment F) or list exceptions.
items.note: Requires a human legal position; must end Needs Evidence and route to Legal.

sections.title: Experience, References and Team
intro: Orion values demonstrated delivery of comparable programs.

items.text: Provide at least two case studies of cloud modernization programs of similar scale completed in the last three years.
Provide three customer references, including contact details and the scope of services delivered.
Provide CVs for the proposed project manager, solution architect, and security lead.
Describe the certifications held by proposed team members (e.g., PMP, CISSP, cloud architect certifications).
Describe your experience with logistics or transportation sector customers.
Confirm whether your company publishes an audited sustainability report and holds ISO 14001 certification.
Describe how you ensure staff continuity and the process for replacing key personnel.

sections.title: Evaluation Criteria and Award
intro: Proposals are evaluated on technical fit (40%), security and compliance (25%), commercial value (20%) and experience (15%). Orion may award without further discussion.

items.text: Shortlisted vendors must be available for a two-hour solution demonstration during the week of 16 November 2026.

outro: Appendix A - Glossary. Terms used in this RFP carry their ordinary commercial meaning unless defined in the contract.
